papers.title_en: Clinical applications of wearable sensor-based gait analysis in athletes: a systematic review for injury prevention and rehabilitation
papers.title_zh: 可穿戴传感器步态分析在运动员临床应用中的作用：一项用于损伤预防和康复的系统综述
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: Evaluating the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes, examining its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and identifying methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration identifies key challenges.
papers.abstract_en: Gait analysis is fundamental for optimizing athletic performance and mitigating injury risks in sports medicine. While traditional laboratory assessments offer insights, the emergence of wearable sensor technology provides novel opportunities for objective, real-time gait evaluation in ecologically valid settings. This systematic review aims to (1) evaluate the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes (2), examine its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and (3) identify methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration. Adhering to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a systematic search was conducted across MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase from inception to May 31st, 2025. papers.abstract_zh: 步态分析对于优化运动员表现和降低运动医学中的损伤风险至关重要。尽管传统的实验室评估提供了见解，但可穿戴传感器技术的出现为在生态有效环境中进行客观、实时步态评估提供了新的机遇。本系统综述旨在 (1) 评估基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员损伤预防中的临床疗效，(2) 考察其在康复监测和临床决策中的作用，以及 (3) 识别方法学局限性和未来研究方向。

papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 展望未来：离心阻力训练对青少年运动员身体表现指标影响的系统综述
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. papers.abstract_zh: 背景：离心阻力训练被认为是增强成人肌肉力量和爆发力的有效刺激；然而，其在青少年运动员中的价值目前尚不清楚。目的：本系统综述旨在批判性评估离心阻力训练对18岁及以下青少年运动员身体表现指标（即肌肉力量、跳跃、冲刺和变向）的影响。方法：本研究检索了1950年至2022年6月期间发表的原始期刊文章。

papers.title_en: Effects of different dietary supplements combined with conditioning training on muscle strength, jump performance, sprint speed, and muscle mass in athletes: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
papers.title_zh: 不同膳食补充剂联合体能训练对运动员肌肉力量、跳跃表现、冲刺速度和肌肉质量的影响：一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析
papers.tldr_en: Protein supplementation appears to be the most effective strategy for increasing muscular strength; β-alanine and creatine both improve jump performance, with β-alanine offering marginally superior effectiveness; and creatine is particularly beneficial for sprint speed.
papers.abstract_en: Background As dietary supplements have become integral to meeting athletes’ specialised nutritional requirements, research into their effects on performance has intensified. Yet inconsistent findings leave the efficacy of some supplements—most notably branched-chain amino acids and β-hydroxy-β-methylbutyrate (HMB)—open to debate. To clarify which products offer the greatest benefit, we undertook a systematic review and network meta-analysis aimed at identifying the supplements most effective for athletes, including protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, vitamin D, caffeine, and others. Methods PubMed, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, Embase and SPORTDiscus were searched from database inception to 15 March 2024 for RCTs evaluating the effects of dietary supplements (including but not limited to protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, caffeine, and vitamin D) on athletic performance. papers.abstract_zh: 背景：随着膳食补充剂成为满足运动员特殊营养需求不可或缺的一部分，对其性能影响的研究日益增多。然而，不一致的研究结果使得某些补充剂（最著名的是支链氨基酸和β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸 (HMB)）的功效仍存在争议。为了阐明哪些产品能提供最大益处，我们进行了一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析，旨在识别对运动员最有效的补充剂，包括蛋白质、肌酸、β-丙氨酸、HMB、维生素D、咖啡因等。方法：本研究检索了PubMed、Web of Science、Scopus和SPORTDiscus数据库，截至2023年4月1日。

papers.title_en: Writing High-Quality Case Studies in Sport Science.
papers.title_zh: 撰写运动科学领域的高质量案例研究
papers.journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
papers.abstract_en:
PURPOSE
Sport-physiology and -performance research often relies on group designs that compare experimental and control groups and/or preintervention and postintervention results. This commentary highlights the key elements of a high-quality case study and provides clear guidelines for readers and authors of the International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance. We propose 4 essential components. First, case studies should offer relevant and original insights by tackling novel issues and defining a clear purpose. Second, they must employ rigorous methodology, encompassing careful participant selection, comprehensive data collection from diverse sources (eg, interviews, surveys, physiological tests, training diaries, competition data), and deliberate data analysis that explicitly addresses factors influencing performance changes. papers.abstract_zh: 目的：运动生理学和运动表现研究通常依赖于比较实验组和对照组以及/或干预前和干预后结果的群体设计。本评论旨在强调高质量案例研究的关键要素，并为《国际运动生理学与表现杂志》的读者和作者提供明确的指导。我们提出了四个基本组成部分。首先，案例研究应通过解决新颖问题和明确研究目的来提供相关且原创的见解。其次，它们必须采用严谨的方法，包括仔细的参与者选择、详细的干预措施描述和全面的结果评估。

papers.title_en: AI-driven medical image analysis for sports injury diagnosis and prevention
papers.title_zh: 人工智能驱动的医学图像分析在运动损伤诊断与预防中的应用
papers.tldr_en: An AI-driven framework integrating deep learning, biomechanical modeling, and adaptive decision-making for injury prediction and rehabilitation optimization is proposed, paving the way for more accurate, interpretable, and responsive injury management systems.
papers.abstract_en: Sports-related injuries present significant challenges in diagnosis, prevention, and rehabilitation, often requiring precise assessments across multiple imaging modalities. Traditional diagnostic approaches rely on manual interpretation, which is time-consuming and prone to variability. To address these limitations, we propose an AI-driven framework integrating deep learning, biomechanical modeling, and adaptive decision-making for injury prediction and rehabilitation optimization. The Biomechanically-Informed Neural Network (BINN) fuses kinematic, physiological, and performance data using attention mechanisms, enhancing both interpretability and predictive accuracy. BINN processes motion capture data through convolutional and recurrent layers, extracting meaningful biomechanical patterns to assess movement efficiency and injury risk. papers.abstract_zh: 运动相关损伤在诊断、预防和康复方面提出了重大挑战，通常需要对多种影像学模态进行精确评估。传统的诊断方法依赖于人工判读，这既耗时又容易出现变异性。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了一个人工智能驱动的框架，该框架整合了深度学习、生物力学建模和自适应决策，用于损伤预测和康复优化。生物力学信息神经网络 (BINN) 利用注意力机制融合了运动学、生理学和性能数据，以提供对损伤风险和治疗反应的全面洞察。

papers.title_en: Impact of Neural network-quantified musical groove on cyclists’ joint coordination and muscle synergy: a repeated measures study
papers.title_zh: 神经网络量化的音乐律动对骑行者关节协调和肌肉协同的影响：一项重复测量研究
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学1区/工程：生物医学2区/神经科学2区 TOP
papers.tldr_en: High-groove music promotes more coordinated movement patterns during cycling through two key mechanisms: optimized joint coordination, particularly in proximal–distal (hip-ankle) and axial (pelvis-torso) linkages, and reorganization of neuromuscular control strategies evidenced by increased synergy complexity and selective activation of postural stabilizers (SOL).
papers.abstract_en: While music is known to influence exercise performance through auditory-motor coupling, the biomechanical mechanisms by which musical groove—characterized by rhythmic drive and movement-inducing qualities—modulates cycling coordination remain poorly understood. This study investigates how groove levels systematically alter lower extremity kinematics and neuromuscular control during high-torque cycling. Twenty-four well-trained, right-handed cyclists completed high-torque cycling trials under three counterbalanced conditions: metronome (control), low-groove (LG), and high-groove (HG) music, with groove levels objectively classified by a validated deep learning model (R2 = 0.85). papers.abstract_zh: 尽管已知音乐通过听觉-运动耦合影响运动表现，但音乐律动（以节奏驱动和运动诱导特性为特征）调节骑行协调的生物力学机制仍知之甚少。本研究调查了律动水平如何系统性地改变高扭矩骑行过程中下肢运动学和神经肌肉控制。二十四名训练有素的右撇子骑行者在三种平衡条件（节拍器（对照）、低律动（LG）和高律动（HG）音乐）下完成了高扭矩骑行试验。
